description: TEMPLATE (v1.13, X-P1-2): documented US equity regulatory fee values for the opt-in VenueSpec / CostModel fields sell_notional_fee_bps, per_share_fee_all, per_share_fee_cap, per_share_fee_sell_only. Nothing loads this file by default; copy the block for the period you replay into a venue row (configs/venues) or pass it to CostModel.with_regulatory_fees. Defaults everywhere stay 0.

periods.label: 2019 (Nasdaq TotalView-ITCH sample days)
periods.sec_source: https://www.sec.gov/news/press-release/2019-30 (Fee Rate Advisory #2 FY2019: $20.70 per million for charge dates on/after 2019-04-16; $13.00 before)
periods.finra_source: FINRA By-Laws Schedule A Section 1 (Trading Activity Fee, covered equity sales): $0.000119 per share, max $5.95 per trade, in force in 2019; see https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/rule-filings/sr-finra-2024-019/fee-adjustment-schedule for the schedule history

periods.label: current (2026)
periods.sec_source: https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories/2026-2 (FY2026: $0.00 per million through 2026-04-03, $20.60 per million on/after 2026-04-04)
periods.finra_source: https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/rule-filings/sr-finra-2024-019/fee-adjustment-schedule (TAF covered equity sales 2026: $0.000195 per share, max $9.79 per trade)
